Description: Verify clicking a toast dismisses it immediately.
Test Steps: 1. Click toast 2. Assert dismissed immediately

Description: Verify multiple toasts stack correctly without overlapping.
Test Steps: 1. Trigger multiple operations 2. Assert toasts stack 3. Assert no overlap

Description: Verify toast icons match the notification type.
Test Steps: 1. Check each toast type 2. Assert icon matches type

Description: Verify toast messages are readable and not truncated.
Test Steps: 1. Assert message fully visible 2. Assert text not truncated 3. Assert contrast ok

Description: Verify toasts appear in a position that doesn't obscure main content.
Test Steps: 1. Trigger toast 2. Assert position correct 3. Assert main content accessible

Description: Verify search input field is present on searchable pages.
Preconditions: User logged in; searchable page open.
Test Steps: 1. Locate search input 2. Assert visible 3. Assert accepts input

Description: Verify typing in search input filters the results list.
Preconditions: User logged in; search input focused.
Test Steps: 1. Type search term 2. Assert results filtered 3. Assert matching items shown

Description: Verify a no-results state is shown when search returns no matches.
Preconditions: User logged in; no matching data.
Test Steps: 1. Type non-matching search term 2. Assert no-results state shown

Description: Verify clear search button resets the search and shows all results.
Test Steps: 1. Click clear search 2. Assert search cleared 3. Assert all results shown

Description: Verify search is case-insensitive.
Preconditions: User logged in; search input focused.
Test Steps: 1. Search uppercase 2. Assert same results as lowercase

Description: Verify search input uses debounce to prevent excessive API calls.
Preconditions: User logged in; search input focused.
Test Steps: 1. Type rapidly 2. Assert API called only after 300ms pause

Description: Verify category filter dropdown filters results by category.
Test Steps: 1. Select category filter 2. Assert results filtered by category

Description: Verify date range filter filters results by date.
Preconditions: User logged in; date filter available.
Test Steps: 1. Select date range 2. Assert results filtered by date

Description: Verify ascending sort correctly orders results.
Preconditions: User logged in; sortable list visible.
Test Steps: 1. Click sort ascending 2. Assert items in ascending order

Description: Verify descending sort correctly orders results.
Preconditions: User logged in; sortable list visible.
Test Steps: 1. Click sort descending 2. Assert items in descending order

Description: Verify service worker is registered for PWA functionality.
Test Steps: 1. Check navigator.serviceWorker 2. Assert registration active 3. Assert scope correct

Description: Verify web app manifest.json is present and linked.
Test Steps: 1. Check link rel=manifest 2. Assert href resolves 3. Assert JSON valid

Description: Verify install prompt fires on supported browsers.
Test Steps: 1. Assert beforeinstallprompt event fires 2. Assert install button shows

Description: Verify app remains functional in offline mode.
Test Steps: 1. Simulate offline 2. Navigate 3. Assert cached content shown 3. Assert no blank page

Description: Verify push notification permission request works.
Test Steps: 1. Assert push permission request fires 2. Assert UI handles granted/denied

Description: Verify background sync is registered for offline-capable operations.
Test Steps: 1. Check sync registration 2. Assert tag present

Description: Verify cached assets are served before network on repeat visits.
Test Steps: 1. Load page 2. Check service worker cache 3. Assert assets served from cache

Description: Verify 192x192 app icon is present in the manifest.
Test Steps: 1. Read manifest.icons 2. Assert 192x192 entry present

Description: Verify 512x512 app icon is present in the manifest.
Test Steps: 1. Read manifest.icons 2. Assert 512x512 entry present

Description: Verify splash screen is shown on PWA launch.
Test Steps: 1. Launch installed PWA 2. Assert splash screen appears briefly

Description: Verify title tag is present and not empty.
Test Steps: 1. Check document.title 2. Assert not empty 3. Assert meaningful

Description: Verify meta description tag is present.
Test Steps: 1. Check meta description 2. Assert content not empty 3. Assert < 160 chars

Description: Verify Open Graph title meta tag is present.
Test Steps: 1. Check meta og:title 2. Assert content not empty

Description: Verify Open Graph description meta tag is present.
Test Steps: 1. Check meta og:description 2. Assert content not empty

Description: Verify Open Graph image meta tag is present.
Test Steps: 1. Check meta og:image 2. Assert content is valid URL

Description: Verify Twitter card meta tags are present.
Test Steps: 1. Check meta twitter:card 2. Assert content set

Description: Verify canonical URL link element is set.
Test Steps: 1. Check link rel=canonical 2. Assert href set correctly

Description: Verify robots meta tag is not set to noindex in production.
Test Steps: 1. Check meta robots 2. Assert not noindex in production

Description: Verify structured data (JSON-LD) is valid and present.
Test Steps: 1. Check script type=application/ld+json 2. Assert valid JSON 3. Assert schema correct

Description: Verify sitemap.xml is linked in robots.txt.
Test Steps: 1. Check robots.txt 2. Assert Sitemap: entry present 3. Assert sitemap reachable
